source.publisher: Derry Journal (via the British Newspaper Archive)
source.check: returned unopposed: the only nomination for the division in 'the full list of nominations' (Derry Journal 18 May 1955 p2; Londonderry Sentinel 19 May 1955 p4, image read), where '*' denotes a retiring member; contests were held only in Bellarena, Drumsurn and Dungiven.

note: Triennial election of the rural district councillors, polled Thursday 2 June 1955. Three contests; the report says there were three, although an earlier nominations report had expected four (Derry Journal, 3 June 1955, p. 1). Eleven unopposed members added (Aghanloo to Gelvin) from the full nominations list (Derry Journal, 18 May 1955, p. 2; Londonderry Sentinel, 19 May 1955, p. 4), whose printed text stops at Gelvin; Glenshane, Keady, Killywool, Lislane, Myroe, Owenreagh, Scriggan, Straw and The Highlands are not yet found (round-2 gap-fill, 7 Nov 2026). Returned unopposed.
